ValidationRule.description: Account cannot be changed on a Primary Quote
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( ISCHANGED(SBQQ__Account__c), SBQQ__Primary__c=true), AND( OR( SBQQ__Account__c <> SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Ship_To_Account__c, Ship_To_Account__c <> SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Ship_To_Account__c), ISCHANGED(SBQQ__Primary__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update the Account on a Primary Quote. Uncheck "Primary" on this Quote, update the Account on the Opportunity and click New Quote to create a new primary Quote record
